draft.reply:
Hi,

Thank you for reaching out, and I'm sorry to hear the annual plan hasn't worked out for you so far.

I checked our refund policy: standard refunds are available for charges made within 14 calendar days. Since your annual plan charge was made 20 days ago, it falls outside that window, so it isn't eligible for a standard refund under our normal policy. I also want to note that for annual plans, this 14-day window is based on the charge date itself, and we're not able to offer partial or prorated refunds for unused time outside that window.

That said, requests like yours can be reviewed as a goodwill exception, and that decision has to be made by a support manager rather than by me. I'm escalating your request to a manager now so they can take a closer look at your account and get back to you with a decision.

Thanks for your patience while this is being reviewed.

Best,
Loopwise Support
